message: `Bag.equal` needs endless instantiations: `Bag.equal<T>` calls `Bag.equal<Bag<T>>`, which calls `Bag.equal<Bag<Bag<T>>>`, and so on
fix: where `Bag.equal` calls itself, call it at its own type parameters: `Bag.equal<T>`
